sentences.text: Harley Quinn -LRB- Harleen Frances Quinzel -RRB- is a fictional supervillain appearing in American comic books published by DC Comics .	DC Comics	DC Comics	supervillain	supervillain
The character was created by Paul Dini and Bruce Timm , and first appeared in Batman : The Animated Series in September 1992 .	Paul Dini	Paul Dini	Bruce Timm	Bruce Timm	Batman	Batman

She later appeared in DC Comics ' Batman comic books , with the character 's first comic book appearance in The Batman Adventures # 12 -LRB- September 1993 -RRB- .	DC Comics	DC Comics	Batman	Batman	The Batman Adventures	The Batman Adventures

Harley Quinn is the frequent accomplice and lover of the Joker , whom she met while working as a psychiatric intern at Gotham City 's Arkham Asylum , where the Joker was a patient .	Joker	Joker (character)	Gotham City	Gotham City	Arkham Asylum	Arkham Asylum
Her name is a play on the name `` Harlequin '' , a character which originated in the commedia dell ` arte .	Harlequin	Harlequin
The character was originally voiced by Arleen Sorkin in various tie-ins to the DC animated universe .	Arleen Sorkin	Arleen Sorkin	DC animated universe	DC animated universe

Since then , she has also been voiced by Hynden Walch and Tara Strong in either DC Animated Showcases or in various video games .	Tara Strong	Tara Strong	Hynden Walch	Hynden Walch	video games	List of Batman video games
In the Birds of Prey television series , she was portrayed by actress Mia Sara .	Mia Sara	Mia Sara
The character made her live-action cinematic debut in the 2016 film Suicide Squad , portrayed by Margot Robbie .	Suicide Squad	Suicide Squad (film)	Margot Robbie	Margot Robbie
